content:
elaine: Quick thread idea: expose per-route "inspect samples" in Console but with strict PII guardrails. Want fast debugging without opening the floodgates.

omar: concrete: separate toys or one pipeline?

elaine: one telemetry stream, each sample labeled as INSPECT or ARCHIVE. INSPECT is short-lived and Console-only; ARCHIVE goes to secure audit store.

ruth: we should avoid raw floats for confidence. Suggest bands: LOW / MED / HIGH and a small reason tag like 'email', 'credit-like', 'ocr-attachment'.

ben: defaults: text routes get a tiny inspect rate (0.01%); anything that accepts files, embeddings, or generates attachments is auto-disabled for inspect. tenants must opt-in with a justification.

sec-bot: policy-scan: /v1/file/upload sensitivity=0.96 -> auto-disable for inspect.

elaine: exactly. Also require an RBAC step: anyone opening an INSPECT sample must enter a justification string; store (actor + reason) in audit trail. INSPECT views expire in 24h.

omar: ops need a single big switch to kill all INSPECT sampling instantly. Also quota ceilings per-org so accidental spikes don't blow budget.

ruth: UI idea: small badge next to route config: "inspect: 0.01% (text) / archive: 0.001%" click to expand a preview that shows banded confidence histogram and top reason tags.

ben: cost preview: when slider changes show projected monthly token cost = recent_30d_volume * avg_tokens * new_rate. If > org budget show warning and require owner approval.

elaine: telemetry: emit counters for banded_confidence by route and weekly job to diff redaction effectiveness vs gold prompts (hook into Optimize alerting).

om ar: edge-case: sometimes redaction classifier mislabels token boundaries and hides too much. We should capture both before-scrub and after-scrub diffs for sampled INSPECT items, but only for text routes and with tenant opt-in.

ruth: compliance: add explicit list of route patterns that are never eligible for INSPECT without legal sign-off (payment_webhooks, file_ingest, embedding_export).

elaine: proposed API-ish snippet for infra/product sync:

```
route: /v1/chat
inspect_sampling:
  inspect_rate: 1e-4        # 0.01% visible in Console for 24h
  archive_rate: 1e-5        # 0.001% to audit store
  attachments_allowed: false
redaction_display: banded    # low/med/high
reason_tags: true
```

ben: operational: implement priority order: global kill-switch > org cap > route override. Show banner if global kill active.

omar: infra will add the kill-switch endpoint and quota enforcement. We'll also add an event to the audit log whenever any tenant opts into attachments sampling.

ruth: one more: make the Console search filterable by redaction band and reason tag so engineers can triage common false-negatives quickly.

elaine: next steps: I'll draft an RFC and a tiny Console mock. assigning infra owner: @omar, product owner: @ruth. will drop RFC link here when ready. :mag:
